QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_7

question.text: Under the workbook's discussion of ZCZP instruments, the tenure of a ZCZP is:

answer.text: Always one year regardless of the funded project
Always two years regardless of the funded project
Always five years regardless of the funded project
Specific to the instrument and equal to the duration of the project specified in the fundraising document

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook explains that ZCZPs have a specific tenure, projects are completed within the duration specified in the fundraising document, and the ZCZP tenure equals the duration of the funded project. There is no fixed one-, two- or five-year requirement. The Trap: Fixed-tenure answers contradict the workbook, which ties ZCZP tenure to the underlying project duration disclosed in the fundraising document. Note: Align the SIA engagement schedule (baseline, mid-line, end-line) with the ZCZP tenure disclosed in the fundraising document.
